what: household sizes (persons per household) of the CEWP twin's focal street leaf, from the twin's own code path (MicroWorld::from_leaf -> populate -> popchain::persons_per_household), MODEL
seed_scheme: leaf k = 0..16666 is HolonId { level: 6, i: 0, j: k } (a synthetic id sequence); the world's seed is that id's HolonId::seed() as on the page; dwelling hi draws from Rng::new(seed ^ (hi + 1) * 0xA24B_AED4_963E_E407); MicroParams::default() (persons_per_household 2.5, the page never sets it)
conditioning: none: one histogram; a household's size depends only on the leaf seed, its dwelling index, the leaf's people and its dwelling count (not density class, region or building type)
